messages:
Alex: Kickoff: NorthStar Health POC goes live Mon morning. Need final decisions on sample dataset, redaction policy, storage (S3 vs NFS), and network plan (VPC peering vs PrivateLink). Also they're asking about Dedicated trial credits vs hosted pricing.

Morgan: Assigning SE. Quick Q — will PHI be present in the sample? If yes we need to confirm redaction & KMS.

Priya: Confirmed — they will include PHI. I sent them the security questionnaire; waiting on section 2 (data flows). Devon, can you confirm acceptable KMS setups and audit log options by EOD?

Devon: We support SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS for hosted. For Private we accept customer-managed CMKs (HSM/KMS). Audit logs: enable CloudTrail + object-level logging. Suggested answer for Q3: "Data at rest is encrypted with SSE-KMS; keys can be customer-managed for Private deployments." Will send a short paragraph.

Samir: Pricing note — for POC we can offer a 14-day Dedicated trial (up to 200 GPU hours) or hosted credits (tiered). If they pick Dedicated we need a signed trial SOW.

Morgan: For sample data: ask for 1-2 weeks of representative records, 5-10k docs max. Need schema CSV + a prompt set (50 prompts) and expected outputs for evals. Success criteria suggestion:
- throughput: 50 qps sustained with p95 latency < 300ms
- quality: F1 >= 0.78 on their eval set
- security: all PHI redacted in saved artifacts

Alex: Can we use presigned S3 uploads only (no egress from their side)? Priya, can you request a minimal manifest with file paths and redaction map from them?

Priya: Sending example manifest to them today. Example manifest (one-line CSV accepted):

```
file_path,record_count,redaction_level
s3://rdw-ns-poc/input/claims_2026_03_01.jsonl,1200,PII
```

Also attaching a sample redaction rule they can run client-side before upload:

```
redaction_regexes:
  - name: ssn
    pattern: "\\\\b\\\\d{3}-\\\\d{2}-\\\\d{4}\\\\b"
    replace_with: "REDACTED_SSN"
```

infra-bot: Sandbox provisioned: s3://rdw-ns-poc-1923 created, VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d, presigned upload endpoint https://upload.redwood.example/presign TTL=24h

Devon: Networking checklist: if they want VPC peering we need their VPC ID + CIDR and an RCF for peering. If PrivateLink, we need their route table IDs and accepted security groups. Quick Terraform snippet for peering (share with infra):

```
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-aaaaaaa"
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-bbbbbbb"
}
```

Priya: I'll collect their CIDR and sample credentials. Samir, please confirm which pricing path you'd like to offer (Dedicated trial SOW or hosted credits) so I can update the POC kickoff deck.

Samir: Let's offer Dedicated trial first; include hosted fallback in case they can't do peering. I'll draft the SOW today.

Alex: Great. Action items:
- Priya: collect manifest, CIDR, and redaction map (due EOD today)
- Devon: provide copyable security answers for sec questionnaire (due EOD)
- Morgan: prepare eval harness template with 50 prompts (due tomorrow)
- Samir: draft trial SOW (due today)

Alex: Any blockers? :thumbsup:

Priya: No blockers on my side, pinging customer for manifest.

Morgan: Working on eval harness now.

infra-bot: Note: presigned URL will expire in 24h — request a new one via /provision if needed.

Samir: I'll post SOW draft in this thread when ready.

Alex: Thanks team — looping back in the morning for final sign-offs.
